title: JNDI/Log4Shell lookup (obfuscated ${upper:}/${lower:}, Java-gated)
remediation: Do not evaluate untrusted input as a lookup/expression. Patch Log4j/limit JNDI lookups (log4j2.formatMsgNoLookups / remove JndiLookup), disable remote codebase loading (com.sun.jndi.*.object.trustURLCodebase=false), and treat message/EL interpolation of user data as unsafe. The inbound callback proves the lookup fired.
